*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**[[Kenya]] confirms its first imported case of the [[Bundibugyo ebolavirus|Bundibugyo]] strain of the [[Ebolavirus]] in [[Nairobi]] in a deceased male who traveled from the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]].
